# OgreBot for EverQuest II - documentation

> The new OgreBot (in beta testing): what every window and option does, and how to move scripts written for OgreBot Classic. The website: https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/

To convert a Classic script, follow the procedure on the Converting your scripts page (Developers, below); its tool (ogre_convert.py) and data file are linked there.

## Read it all

- [Everything in one document](https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/llms-full.txt): the entire documentation, 748 KB. If that is too much to read at once, use the smaller pieces below - together they are the same text.
- [Start here](https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/llms-start-here.txt): 80 KB - Start here
- [OgreBot (part 1 of 3)](https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/llms-ogrebot-1.txt): 95 KB - OgreBot; OgreBot - Tabs
- [OgreBot (part 2 of 3)](https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/llms-ogrebot-2.txt): 96 KB - OgreBot - Tabs
- [OgreBot (part 3 of 3)](https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/llms-ogrebot-3.txt): 50 KB - OgreBot - Tabs
- [Windows (part 1 of 4)](https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/llms-windows-1.txt): 94 KB - Windows - Everyday; Windows - Running content
- [Windows (part 2 of 4)](https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/llms-windows-2.txt): 95 KB - Windows - Running content; Windows - Loot and items
- [Windows (part 3 of 4)](https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/llms-windows-3.txt): 98 KB - Windows - Loot and items; Windows - Crafting; Windows - Groups and accounts; Windows - Tools
- [Windows (part 4 of 4)](https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/llms-windows-4.txt): 55 KB - Windows - Tools
- [Developers](https://kannkor.github.io/ISXOgre/EQ2/bot/llms-developers.txt): 88 KB - Developers; Developers - Guides

Each page on its own, as plain Markdown, in menu order:
